summary: Woman died on Lake Pueblo on Saturday following a boating accident despite life-saving measures attempted by CPW staff; victim unidentified and no official cause of death published
notes: Parent-verified CPR 2022-07-10 story: two separate Lake Pueblo deaths 'last week' — Thursday (id 2616) and Saturday July 9 (this row); if both confirmed drownings, Lake Pueblo alone had 6 water deaths in 2022
